Two people got into a car accident at the corner today, one of the drivers was a 55-year-old and the other driver a 24-year-old. The 24-year-old had been going 55mph in a 30mph zone and wasn't able to stop in time to avoid hitting the 55-year-old when he came to a full stop at the stop sign. Who was acting recklessly?
A. The 24-year-old
B. The 55-year-old
C. Unknown
